title: Flávio and PL Lead Misuse of AI in Elections
seoTitle: Flávio and PL Lead Misuse of AI
subtitle: Observatory reveals nearly two-thirds of political content is irregularly produced by artificial intelligence
excerpt: A survey by the AI in Elections Observatory shows nearly 66% of political material is created using AI improperly, with Flávio and the PL leading the practice.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A survey conducted by the AI in Elections Observatory, an initiative developed by Data Privacy Brasil and Aláfia Lab, revealed that nearly two out of three pieces of political content are produced through the misuse of artificial intelligence.

Within this scenario, Flávio and the PL were identified as leading this practice, according to the observatory's analysis.

The study highlights the need for attention to political content production practices, especially when there are signs of inappropriate use of automated technologies.

With information from Agência Brasil.
